name: Community — MiniMax H3 (PDD Acc 8-Step)
author: alibaba-pai + Jalen-Brunson
description: Alibaba's OFFICIAL 8-step acceleration LoRA for MiniMax H3, trained with Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD, Shaul et al. 2026). Guidance is distilled in, so this runs CFG-free at 8 sampler steps instead of the official 20. Measured in SimpliGen on a 4070 Ti at 864x480/5s with faster attention on: 114.3s, verified applying (258 LoRA modules, heads fused, trunk fingerprint checked against the model). For scale, the same machine runs the official 20-step MiniMax H3 recipe at 420.8s and this pack's own graph at 266.4s on stock ComfyUI without faster attention. It is NOT faster than the Community Fully Accelerated pack (111.7s) - that is a dead heat. What it gives you instead is Alibaba's official distill rather than a stacked third-party chain, and markedly more coherent motion: in the same image region of the same shot the 20-step render scored 0.033 and this scored 7.684, with the movement localised to the subject instead of the whole frame. This is NOT an ordinary LoRA: the file carries a rank-64 trunk LoRA plus a 32-interval parallel-decoding head bank, and the sampler schedule comes from the file's own trained block boundaries. A plain LoRA loader cannot read it and silently drops the distill, which is why the dedicated node pack is required. The recipe is fixed and the node enforces it: euler sampler, CFG 1.0, sigma shift exactly 12.0/3.0, sigmas from the Apply node, 8 steps. Off-grid step counts are REFUSED rather than silently degraded. Do not combine with another distill LoRA (Turbo/lightx2v) or a step-caching pack (Spectrum, EasyCache) - distills do not stack and there is nothing to cache in 8 steps. Character LoRAs stack normally via SimpliGen's LoRA slot. Timings above were measured WITHOUT faster attention; the preset still declares support for it, so SimpliGen applies it when enabled and withdraws it if your GPU crashes on it.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-PDD-Acc
extensions.description: Loads Alibaba's official PDD acceleration LoRA - the rank-64 trunk AND the parallel-decoding head bank, plus the trained sigma schedule. A plain LoRA loader silently drops the head bank. NOT pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ. The workflow does not patch attention itself - SimpliGen injects that node when faster attention is on - but the node must be installed for the injection to resolve.

requirements.notes: Same base weights as SimpliGen's official MiniMax H3 pack plus a 1.28 GB PDD file in models/pdd_acc/. Needs ComfyUI v0.33.0 or newer; the node fails closed with an update message on older cores.
